name: Aptonoth
description: Peaceful herd herbivores. When danger appears, the group flees together.

name: Jagras
description: Pack-hunting fanged wyverns that share territory with Great Jagras and attack vulnerable prey.

name: Mernos
description: Forest wingdrakes that feed on vegetation. Hunters can use them for aerial transport.

name: Vespoid
description: Flying insects with a paralysing sting. Their fragile bodies can be destroyed before carving.

name: Mosswine
description: Small pigs that use their keen sense of smell to search for mushrooms.

name: Apceros
description: Armoured herbivores that defend their herd rather than immediately fleeing.

name: Kestodon
description: Territorial herbivores that defend themselves with headbutts. Males and females have different builds.

name: Noios
description: Desert wingdrakes whose cries can startle other monsters.

name: Gajau
description: Aggressive fish that lunge from shallow water at nearby intruders.

name: Kelbi
description: Timid, agile herbivores recognised by their valuable horns.

name: Raphinos
description: Coral Highlands wingdrakes that feed on the local vegetation.

name: Shamos
description: Nocturnal fanged wyverns that gather in packs in the Coral Highlands.

name: Girros
description: Pack-living fanged wyverns whose bites can cause paralysis.

name: Hornetaur
description: Armoured insects that scavenge in the Rotten Vale. Their bodies are easily damaged.

name: Gastodon
description: Territorial herbivores with strong foreheads, adapted to the heat of the Recess.

name: Barnos
description: Wingdrakes that thrive in the volcanic environment of the Elder’s Recess.

name: Popo
description: Cold-adapted herd herbivores with thick fur and long tusks.

name: Anteka
description: Timid tundra herbivores that defend themselves with their antlers when cornered.

name: Wulg
description: Furred fanged wyverns that hunt in groups and can cling to a hunter.

name: Cortos
description: Hoarfrost Reach wingdrakes adapted to its freezing climate.

name: Gajalaka
description: Masked Lynians that use weapons and status-inflicting attacks. They can become useful allies through the cultural-exchange quests.

description: Hoarfrost Reach Lynians that hunt with spears. Their tribe can be befriended through the local cultural-exchange quests.
